title: nav-pilot agentpakke release metadata (v1)
description: The agentpakke-release.json asset on a GitHub release of an agentpakke. nav-pilot moves a pin that follows releases only to the source revision a stable release names here. The repo is the one the pakke was installed from, never a value in this file. The release must be published, not a draft, not a prerelease, and immutable; its tag, with an optional "<prefix>/" (which must equal name) and an optional "v" removed, must equal version. See docs/README.agentpakke.md in navikt/copilot.

schemaVersion.description: The metadata format. nav-pilot reads 1 and refuses anything else.

name.description: The agentpakke manifest's name. A release naming another package is another product published from the same repo, and is skipped.

version.description: The package version, strict SemVer MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: no "v", no prerelease, no build metadata. A version is never published again with a different sourceSha.

sourceSha.description: The full commit the payloads are built from, 40 lowercase hex characters. It must be on the repo's default branch.
